facts.business: Polytex India Limited is a company with NIL income and operations impacted by cancellation of its NBFC licence, currently exploring new business opportunities.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: 1) Valuation of unquoted investments subject to independent valuer, valuation report not available. 2) Non-compliance with IND AS-19 for employee benefits. Material uncertainty related to going concern: loss of Rs. 14.51 lakhs, current liabilities exceed current assets by Rs. 47.50 lakhs; financial statements prepared on going concern basis based on promoter financial support undertaking.

key_risks: Cancellation of NBFC licence impacting operations
Material uncertainty related to going concern due to losses and negative net current assets
Valuation of unquoted investments not completed
Non-compliance with IND AS-19 for employee benefits
Dependence on promoter financial support for continuing operations
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were on arm's length basis and in ordinary course of business. No materially significant related party transactions. Unsecured loan of Rs. 8,33,507 accepted from Mr. Arvind Mulji Kariya, Director. Policy posted on company website.
